Definition: probably akin to G5530 through the idea of contact; to smear or rub with oil, i.e. (by implication) to consecrate to an office or religious service:--anoint.
BiblicalUsage: To anoint is to smear with oil, and Jesus opens His ministry by reading that the Spirit has anointed Him to preach good news to the poor. The early church prays that God anointed His holy child Jesus, and Hebrews says God anointed Him with the oil of gladness above His fellows. Anointing marks the one God has chosen for a work.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe anointing is God's way of saying the work is His, not ours. Jesus was anointed for the poor, the brokenhearted, and the captive, and that is the shape of His ministry still. I hold that every believer shares in that anointing, because the same Spirit who rested on Him rests on His people.
